{"task": {"id": "I_kwDOVQjccM8AAAABZcaCiw", "item_id": "PVTI_lAHOAHSLSM4Bn3IfzhDDoNI", "project_id": "PVT_kwHOAHSLSM4Bn3If", "number": 35, "title": "Correct V30MZ BUSLOCK decoding for memory and I/O instructions", "body": "## Problem

At baseline `e14d8cb089b0f13a8bcd4e1eb0dcece0240cf71a`, `crates/ws-core/src/cpu.rs:352` restricts F0 BUSLOCK to selected memory read/modify/write instructions. Supported memory MOV, read-only operations and IN/OUT therefore stop with a LOCK diagnostic. The validator also reads the following byte as ModR/M regardless of instruction format, adding an unnecessary bus access. The test at line 1975 and `docs/hardware-subset.md` encode this restrictive policy.

These execution barriers affect all three console models. Commercial-title impact is unmeasured.

## Expected outcome

BUSLOCK-prefixed supported instructions execute with correct decoding and ordinary architectural effects on WonderSwan, WonderSwan Color and SwanCrystal. Preserve existing instruction-boundary scheduling while documenting its remaining timing limits.

## Context

Clean local HEAD and remote main match the baseline. The open Issue/PR collection is empty; inspected closed-work history contains no equivalent correction.

Correction record: the old AI-authored assumption required x86-style memory RMW targets. The corrected requirement follows the [NEC V30MZ hardware manual](https://www.renesas.com/en/document/lbr/v30mztm-hardware-preliminary), §1.3, printed pages 14–16: BUSLOCK applies to memory or I/O access. For instructions without such access, the lock output remains inactive and bus hold remains possible. Treating the prefix as ineffective there, while executing the supported underlying instruction, is an inference from that description. The same section guarantees redundant prefixes through seven total; §5.3 prevents interrupt acknowledgement between a prefix and its instruction.

The manual is preliminary CPU-core evidence, not proof of console DMA wiring or exact prefetch timing. Extracted text was inspected; PDF screenshots failed. Exact bus arbitration, POLL wiring and single-step delivery remain separate gaps.

FPO1 remains separate: Appendix A shows displacement-bearing encodings, while inspected ares decoding consumes only the following byte. Do not silently resolve that discrepancy by copying upstream behavior. Correct the adjacent documentation claim that excluded older NEC extensions and REPC/REPNC are mandatory V30MZ gaps; preserve supported carry/direction flag operations.

[PR #34](https://github.com/takahirox/wonderswan-rust/pull/34) and its [validation record](https://github.com/takahirox/wonderswan-rust/blob/e14d8cb089b0f13a8bcd4e1eb0dcece0240cf71a/docs/issue-33-validation.md) report passing native/build/Chromium checks and Coordinator acceptance review. Existing CPU tests are present, but the LOCK rejection test asserts the old assumption. No builds or tests were run during this planning task.

## Pre-merge acceptance

- [ ] Replace the RMW-only validation and unconditional ModR/M lookahead. Cover supported explicit/implicit memory accesses and I/O without changing their normal decoding, effects or error propagation. Supported register-only/NOP instructions execute with an ineffective lock prefix; unsupported underlying instructions and ports retain diagnostics.
- [ ] Add independent literal-byte CPU vectors across all three models: byte/word memory reads and writes, displacement/immediate forms, read-only comparison, existing RMW, implicit stack access, and IN/OUT through immediate and DX addressing using supported ports. Assert exact IP, registers, flags, memory and port effects; include a following instruction to detect overconsumption and bus-accounting assertions to catch the removed lookahead.
- [ ] Cover repeated BUSLOCK and segment-prefix combinations through seven total prefixes. Keep prefixes and their instruction together for interrupt delivery. Preserve existing bounded REP restart, interrupt shadows, HALT and GDMA/SDMA scheduling regressions. Document any defensive policy beyond the guaranteed prefix range without claiming hardware fidelity.
- [ ] Add an original source-included CC0 cartridge probe through normal footer/banking paths. Check CPU-written results against independent literals natively and through production Wasm/browser execution on all three models, including restart. Extend existing fixture and browser tooling rather than introducing another framework.
- [ ] Preserve existing model gates, audio/PCM, GDMA/SDMA/Hyper Voice, SRAM/cartridge EEPROM/internal EEPROM, firmware-free startup, input, frame continuity and browser persistence behavior. Preserve browser-local ROM/save handling and ownership/provenance; introduce no proprietary assets, copied emulator code or game-specific paths.
- [ ] Coordinator runs and records `python3 fixtures/build.py --check`, `python3 demo/build.py --check`, `cargo fmt --all -- --check`, `cargo test --workspace --locked`, `cargo clippy --workspace --all-targets --locked -- -D warnings` and `git diff --check`. In `web`, run `npm run build:wasm`, `npm run build`, then complete `npm run test:browser` and `npm run test:compat` sequentially against the production preview, including the new probe.
- [ ] Update CPU support documentation, stale comments and fixture provenance. Record the old assumption, corrected requirement, primary source, rationale and remaining uncertainties. Coordinator reviews the final diff and actual validation against every criterion before merge. Evidence-backed corrections require no human approval or independent AI re-review; do not weaken acceptance to accommodate incomplete code or failing checks.

## Optional validation

Compare additional lawful hardware experiments or run another browser engine. Distinguish inspected source from executed results. Commercial ROMs, proprietary firmware and human gameplay are unnecessary for acceptance.

## Required post-merge verification

None.

## Specification reconciliation

This task was authored by AI under the agreed WonderSwan-family hardware goal.
Correct erroneous technical assumptions or acceptance criteria when primary hardware
specifications establish the correction. Update this Issue and record the original
assumption, corrected requirement, primary reference and rationale in the PR.
These technical corrections require neither human approval nor an independent AI
re-review. Preserve the agreed goal and relevant pre-merge acceptance; do not weaken
requirements merely to accommodate incomplete implementation or failing tests.
